run_auto_benchmark: run the auto benchmark pipeline to search optimal server configurations from a YAML config
convert_dataset: convert a dataset to autobench JSONL format with a specified tokenizer and model
validate_dataset: validate an autobench dataset and print a summary of its rows and prompt statistics
build_server_candidates: build server candidate configurations from base flags and tiered search space
prepare_dataset: prepare a dataset for benchmarking by normalizing config and writing autobench JSONL output
